categories.title: Airway, Oxygen And Emergency Care
categories.body: Equipment used to maintain airway, support breathing and manage urgent clinical situations.

items.name: Automated External Defibrillator (AED) & Pads
items.imageAlt: Automated External Defibrillator (AED) & Pads clinical illustration
items.use: Analyses cardiac rhythm automatically and delivers synchronized biphasic shock for shockable rhythms (VF / pulseless VT) in cardiac arrest.
items.preparation: Turn power on immediately, dry bare chest, apply upper-right sternal and lower-left mid-axillary adhesive pads cleanly.
items.sterilization: High-level disinfection or sterile single-use airway disposables per UNMC/WHO IPC standards.
items.safety: Shave/dry chest if wet, remove GTN patches, and shout 'STAND CLEAR' visually checking nobody touches patient or bed before shocking.
examPoints: Identify Automated External Defibrillator (AED) & Pads and match it to Airway, Oxygen And Emergency Care.
State clinical use clearly: Analyses cardiac rhythm automatically and delivers synchronized biphasic shock for shockable rhythms (VF / pulseless VT) in cardiac arrest.
Outline pre-procedure check: Turn power on immediately, dry bare chest, apply upper-right sternal and lower-left mid-axillary adhesive pads cleanly.
Highlight core safety/IPC rule: Shave/dry chest if wet, remove GTN patches, and shout 'STAND CLEAR' visually checking nobody touches patient or bed before shocking.

items.name: Bag-Valve-Mask Resuscitator (Ambu Bag)
items.use: Delivers manual positive-pressure ventilation (with or without high-flow oxygen reservoir) during respiratory arrest, CPR, and neonatal resuscitation.
items.preparation: Inspect self-inflating bag recoil, PEEP/pop-off valve, mask cushion seal, and oxygen tubing connection (10-15 L/min for reservoir fill).
items.sterilization: High-level disinfection or sterile single-use airway disposables per UNMC/WHO IPC standards.
items.safety: Use C-E clamp mask grip; deliver 1 breath every 5-6 seconds in adults (watch gentle chest rise)—avoid hyperventilation.

items.name: Cuffed Tracheostomy Tube with Inner Cannula
items.imageAlt: Cuffed Tracheostomy Tube with Inner Cannula studio reference image
items.use: Maintains a stable artificial airway below the vocal cords for prolonged ventilation, upper airway obstruction, or secretion clearance.
items.preparation: Confirm correct patient size (adult/paediatric), verify oxygen source, valve patency, and suction readiness prior to emergency use.
items.sterilization: Sterile single-patient insertion tube; clean reusable inner cannula using sterile saline/hydrogen peroxide protocols.
items.safety: Keep spare tube (same size and one size smaller) plus tracheal dilators at the bedside at all times for emergency decannulation.
examPoints: Identify Cuffed Tracheostomy Tube with Inner Cannula accurately by visual inspection and state its category (Airway, Oxygen And Emergency Care).
Explain primary indication: Maintains a stable artificial airway below the vocal cords for prolonged ventilation, upper airway obstruction, or secretion clearance.
State reprocessing/sterility requirement: Sterile single-patient insertion tube; clean reusable inner cannula using sterile saline/hydrogen peroxide protocols.
Demonstrate key patient safety precaution: Keep spare tube (same size and one size smaller) plus tracheal dilators at the bedside at all times for emergency decannulation.

items.name: Endotracheal Tube (ETT)
items.use: Secures a definitive sealed airway for mechanical ventilation, positive pressure oxygenation, or general anaesthesia while preventing aspiration.
items.preparation: Confirm correct patient size (adult/paediatric), verify oxygen source, valve patency, and suction readiness prior to emergency use.
items.sterilization: Sterile single-use packed medical PVC; discard immediately after extubation.
items.safety: Always confirm bilateral breath sounds and ETCO2 after intubation; inflate cuff just enough (20-30 cmH2O) to prevent tracheal mucosal necrosis.
examPoints: Identify Endotracheal Tube (ETT) accurately by visual inspection and state its category (Airway, Oxygen And Emergency Care).

items.name: Guedel Oropharyngeal Airway (OPA)
items.imageAlt: Guedel Oropharyngeal Airway (OPA) studio reference image
items.use: Maintains a patent upper airway in deeply unconscious patients without a gag reflex by lifting the tongue off the posterior pharyngeal wall.
items.preparation: Confirm correct patient size (adult/paediatric), verify oxygen source, valve patency, and suction readiness prior to emergency use.
items.sterilization: Single-use disposable (or HLD only where reusable autoclavable polymers are protocols).
items.safety: Never insert in an awake patient with an intact gag reflex (triggers laryngospasm or vomiting); measure from corner of mouth to angle of mandible.

items.name: Jet / Ultrasonic Nebulizer Set
items.imageAlt: Jet / Ultrasonic Nebulizer Set studio reference image
items.use: Converts liquid bronchodilators, hypertonic saline, or adrenaline into continuous mist for severe bronchospasm, croup, or bronchiolitis.
items.preparation: Confirm correct patient size (adult/paediatric), verify oxygen source, valve patency, and suction readiness prior to emergency use.
items.sterilization: Single-patient mask & medication chamber; wash, rinse with sterile water, and air-dry between doses.
items.safety: Run at 6-8 L/min oxygen/air flow; monitor heart rate for tachycardia/tremors with frequent salbutamol nebulization.

items.name: Macintosh & Miller Laryngoscope
items.imageAlt: Macintosh & Miller Laryngoscope studio reference image
items.use: Illuminates and lifts the epiglottis (curved Macintosh in vallecula; straight Miller directly) to visualize vocal cords for endotracheal intubation.
items.preparation: Confirm correct patient size (adult/paediatric), verify oxygen source, valve patency, and suction readiness prior to emergency use.
items.sterilization: High-level disinfection (2% glutaraldehyde) or autoclave detachable blades; wipe handle with 70% alcohol.
items.safety: Test bulb brightness and hinge lock before induction; lift upward along the handle axis—never lever against upper teeth.

items.name: Magill Intubating Forceps
items.use: Angled offset forceps used under direct laryngoscopy to guide nasotracheal tubes, insert throat packs, or remove supraglottic foreign bodies.
items.preparation: Autoclave sterilized; inspect serrated oval tips for clean grip and smooth alignment without sharp burrs.
items.sterilization: High-level disinfection or sterile single-use airway disposables per UNMC/WHO IPC standards.
items.safety: Never clamp directly across an ETT cuff—hold tube body only to prevent cuff perforation.

items.name: Manual Foot-Operated Suction Unit
items.imageAlt: Manual Foot-Operated Suction Unit studio reference image
items.use: Clears blood, vomitus, meconium, or thick secretions from the oropharynx and airway during resuscitation or power outages.
items.preparation: Confirm correct patient size (adult/paediatric), verify oxygen source, valve patency, and suction readiness prior to emergency use.
items.sterilization: Empty & decontaminate collection jar with 0.5% chlorine; sterilize reusable tubing/catheters before storage.
items.safety: Limit negative pressure (<120 mmHg adults, <100 mmHg infants) and keep suctioning under 10 seconds to prevent hypoxia.

items.name: Metered-Dose Inhaler (MDI)
items.use: Delivers precise aerosolized bronchodilator (e.g., salbutamol) or corticosteroid doses directly into the lower airways for asthma and COPD.
items.preparation: Confirm correct patient size (adult/paediatric), verify oxygen source, valve patency, and suction readiness prior to emergency use.
items.sterilization: Patient-dedicated device; wash plastic actuator weekly with warm water and air dry.
items.safety: Pair with a spacer chamber in children or poorly coordinated adults; instruct patient to exhale gently, actuate while inhaling slowly, and hold breath 10 seconds.

items.name: Nasopharyngeal Airway (NPA)
items.use: Soft bevelled airway inserted through a nostril into the posterior pharynx when mouth opening is restricted or gag reflex is partially present.
items.preparation: Size from tip of nose to tragus of ear; coat outside with water-soluble lubricant before gentle insertion along nasal floor.
items.sterilization: High-level disinfection or sterile single-use airway disposables per UNMC/WHO IPC standards.
items.safety: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED in suspected base-of-skull fracture (CSF rhinorrhoea, raccoon eyes) due to risk of intracranial passage.

items.name: Nebulizer Compressor & Mask Tubing
items.imageAlt: Nebulizer Compressor & Mask Tubing clinical illustration
items.use: Portable electric air compressor generating pressurized flow to aerosolize wet respiratory medications directly into small airways.
items.preparation: Assemble clean chamber cup, fill prescribed salbutamol + normal saline volume (total ~3-4 mL), attach upright T-piece/mask.
items.sterilization: High-level disinfection or sterile single-use airway disposables per UNMC/WHO IPC standards.
items.safety: Keep chamber upright throughout treatment; clean air filter monthly and allow components to air dry thoroughly.

items.name: Neonatal Mucus Extractor (DeLee Trap)
items.imageAlt: Neonatal Mucus Extractor (DeLee Trap) studio reference image
items.use: Gently clears amniotic fluid, mucus, or meconium from a newborn's mouth then nostrils while preventing aspiration or cross-contamination.
items.preparation: Confirm correct patient size (adult/paediatric), verify oxygen source, valve patency, and suction readiness prior to emergency use.
items.sterilization: Sterile single-use packed catheter/trap; dispose as infectious medical waste after delivery.
items.safety: Always suction 'Mouth BEFORE Nose' to stop reflex gasping of oral secretions into the trachea; keep bulb pressure gentle.

items.name: Non-Rebreather Oxygen Mask with Reservoir
items.imageAlt: Non-Rebreather Oxygen Mask with Reservoir clinical illustration
items.use: Supplies high-concentration oxygen (60-90% FiO2) in acute trauma, shock, severe sepsis, eclampsia, or status asthmaticus.
items.preparation: Pre-fill reservoir bag with oxygen at 12-15 L/min by depressing valve before placing snugly over patient's nose and mouth.
items.sterilization: High-level disinfection or sterile single-use airway disposables per UNMC/WHO IPC standards.
items.safety: Never run below 10 L/min—reservoir must stay partially inflated during inspiration to avoid CO2 rebreathing.

items.name: Oxygen Concentrator & Humidifier Bottle
items.imageAlt: Oxygen Concentrator & Humidifier Bottle clinical illustration
items.use: Electrically filters ambient air (~21% O2) through zeolite sieve beds to deliver continuous 90-95% medical oxygen on Ugandan hospital wards.
items.preparation: Check clean air intake sponge filter, fill humidifier bottle to marked line with sterile/boiled cooled water ONLY (never tap water).
items.sterilization: High-level disinfection or sterile single-use airway disposables per UNMC/WHO IPC standards.
items.safety: Keep 30 cm away from walls/curtains, enforce strict NO SMOKING / naked flame safety zone, and connect flow splitter safely for paediatrics.

items.name: Venturi Fixed-Performance Oxygen Mask
items.imageAlt: Venturi Fixed-Performance Oxygen Mask clinical illustration
items.use: Delivers precise colour-coded FiO2 concentrations (24% blue, 28% white, 35% yellow, 40% red, 60% green) especially in COPD patients.
items.preparation: Match colour-coded entrainment barrel to prescribed FiO2 and set exact L/min oxygen flow printed on the adaptor.
items.sterilization: High-level disinfection or sterile single-use airway disposables per UNMC/WHO IPC standards.
items.safety: Crucial in COPD type-II respiratory failure to prevent CO2 narcosis while correcting dangerous hypoxaemia (target SpO2 88-92%).

items.name: Yankauer Rigid Suction Tip
items.imageAlt: Yankauer Rigid Suction Tip clinical illustration
items.use: Wide-bore rigid curved suction tip for rapid clearance of thick vomitus, blood, or pooled secretions in the oropharynx.
items.preparation: Attach cleanly to suction tubing, test vacuum occluding vent port, and keep within arm's reach beside intubation tray.
items.sterilization: High-level disinfection or sterile single-use airway disposables per UNMC/WHO IPC standards.
items.safety: Insert only under direct vision into the oropharynx; never push beyond posterior pharynx or apply trauma to tonsillar pillars.

items.name: Allis Tissue Forceps
items.imageAlt: Allis Tissue Forceps studio reference image
items.use: Allis Tissue Forceps — Allis Tissue Forceps is used to hold, grasp, clamp or handle tissue, swabs, dressings or procedure materials depending on its design.
items.preparation: Inspect box locks, ratchet teeth, tip alignment, and chemical indicator tape on sterile wrap before opening onto sterile field.
items.sterilization: Pre-soak in enzymatic detergent, scrub box locks open, and steam autoclave at 134 C (18 min) or 121 C (30 min).
items.safety: Maintain strict surgical instrument counts before incision, before cavity closure, and at skin closure to prevent retained items.
